label.description: Free-form amenity label; no catalog is imposed

Opaque asset reference, not a URL; this API does not upload or fetch the asset

altText.description: Pass null to clear this metadata

pendingCount.description: PENDING events, including delayed retries; decimal string

oldestReadySeconds.description: Seconds since the oldest ready PENDING event was created, or null

amountVnd.description: Non-negative integer VND as a decimal string
Non-negative integer VND as a decimal string

version.description: Present when a policy has been persisted

configuredAmountVnd.description: Configured integer VND, encoded as a decimal string

totalAmountVnd.description: Final amount as an integer VND decimal string

policyVersion.description: Channel deposit-policy version at snapshot time; null when the channel was unconfigured (NONE default)

requiredAmountVnd.description: Required deposit for the snapshotted quote total. FIXED is capped at the total; PERCENT rounds up to whole VND

customerPhone.description: Only present in individual hold responses

customerEmail.description: Only present in individual hold responses

priceSnapshot.description: Immutable server-calculated quote snapshot, only present in individual hold responses

phoneVerifiedAt.description: Time staff recorded a successful verification call; individual responses only

phoneVerifiedBy.description: Staff user who recorded the verification call; individual responses only

depositPolicySnapshot.description: Deposit policy frozen with the price snapshot; individual responses only

phone.description: Phone number for manual verification; digits with optional leading +

expectedTotalAmountVnd.description: Total VND shown by the quote API, as a decimal string

allowed.description: null when no merchant configuration exists
Whether no-deposit confirmation is enabled for this merchant and channel

fixedAmountVnd.description: VND integer string; required only for FIXED

percent.description: Percentage as decimal string with up to four fractional digits; required only for PERCENT

overdueCount.description: Number of overdue holds still awaiting expiration, as a decimal string

oldestOverdueSeconds.description: Age in seconds of the oldest overdue hold; null if none

cancellationTerms.description: Exact cancellation terms shown and agreed for this booking

noDepositAllowed.description: True for the no-deposit path; false when a deposit was required and covered

depositRecordedVnd.description: Deposit-required path only: hold deposits recorded at confirmation

refundAmountVnd.description: CASH refund recorded by staff; "0" when none

checkedOutAt.description: Actual end of use; may be before or after the scheduled end

totalRecordedVnd.description: Sum of recorded payments in VND; decimal string to preserve integer precision

paymentCount.description: Number of recorded manual payment entries

amountVnd.description: Positive integer VND as a decimal string

termsVersion.description: Version returned by the public booking-terms endpoint

depositRequiredVnd.description: Deposit the merchant requires before staff can confirm (snapshotted at hold time); "0" when none is required. Paid in person; no online payment

bookingCode.description: 128-bit lookup code. Store securely; returned again only for matching idempotent replay.

bookingStatus.description: Booking status once staff confirmed the hold

depositRequiredVnd.description: Deposit required before confirmation; "0" when none is required

depositRecordedVnd.description: Deposit recorded by staff so far

depositPolicySnapshot.description: Null until customer details and the price snapshot are recorded

depositSatisfied.description: True when the snapshot requires a deposit and the recorded total covers it

amountVnd.description: Positive integer VND as a decimal string; must not exceed the remaining required deposit

refundAmountVnd.description: CASH refund already handed back, decimal VND; must not exceed recorded deposits plus payments. Staff decides; never computed

platformApproved.description: Separate platform approval; cannot be changed through the merchant API

published.description: Request publication of all active branches and rooms; separate platform approval is required before they appear publicly

version.description: Opaque version that must be submitted when accepting these terms

terms.description: Single public cancellation/booking terms text shown before guest submission

totalAmountVnd.description: Final integer VND amount encoded as a decimal string

platformDecidedBy.description: Platform Admin who made the latest approve/revoke decision

activeBranchCount.description: Active branches that would become publicly visible

note.description: Reviewer note stored in the audit record

reason.description: Reason stored in the audit record
